title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Paaralang Primarya Ng Bagbaguin in the Municipality of Pandi, Province of Bulacan, to Zacarias Hilario Memorial School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of Paaralang Primarya Ng Bagbaguin in the Municipality of Pandi, Province of Bulacan, to Zacarias Hilario Memorial School

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1988/ra_6669_1988.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of Paaralang Primarya ng Bagbagu-in in Municipality of Pandi, Province of Bulacan, is hereby changed to Zacarias Hilario Memorial School.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
